svg.title: Treasury Bodyguard: Plunderspell bestiary concept sheet

text.tspan: Slow, heavily armoured. He closes the distance and hits hard: the
tanky melee check at valuable doors.
A hand-picked, oversized man-at-arms kept at the treasury door, chosen
The heaviest plate the estate owns: breastplate and limb harness over
mail, with a plain great helm.
Poleaxe planted upright and a pavise in the off hand. Less decorated
than the Sergeant, more armoured than anyone.
A planted, square stance. The silhouette says "immovable" before it says
Orpiment: None: he guards the gold, he doesn't wear it.

svg.text: Hand-authored SVG · Tools/bestiary_concept_svg.py · concept thumbnail for paint-over, not final art
